plan_review.notes: Rejected debug-reason/EID inference because add-clearing shares the prefix and sampling cannot define lifecycle. Rejected synthetic-only coverage because it would not prove the three natural seeds. Rejected helper-only observability because the gate needs durable start readiness and duration evidence. Adopted telemetry-only named Floor 1 encounter lifecycle metrics plus exact real-headless gates; no combat behavior change.

independent_grade.notes: Telemetry-only Floor 1 boss lifecycle capture correctly mirrors the existing Floor 2 pattern, records first-start readiness and first-defeat timing from production bossBattles state (including bossEid before defeat clears it), and is emitted on both normal and error runHeadless paths. The three exact historical weapon/seed cases are gated through real headless runs for official victory within the 19,800-frame sweep budget, named encounter start/defeat, entry level/health floors, bounded fight duration, and sampled Boss-room lock-in decisions targeting the lifecycle-captured bossEid (add-clearing reasons are excluded by the targetEid check). No combat/AI behavior changed; scope is limited to types, runner instrumentation, tests, and required session artifacts. Determinism and layer rules are respected. No blocker- or major-severity defects found.
